description: React component for a system role permission dropdown in Mattermost admin console, allowing selection of access levels for system sections.

classes.name: SystemRolePermissionDropdown
classes.description: React component for managing system role permissions via a dropdown menu.

methods.name: updatePermission
methods.description: Updates permissions based on selected access level, handling subsections if present.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a permission option with label and description.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the permission dropdown menu with options for 'Can edit', 'Read only', and 'No access'.
